Racks/Core/DesktopIconManager.cs.why: Creates and styles the RacksWorkspace folder, its hidden icon and desktop.ini and writes the library file: the app's own folder, not user data. Moves to the broker or a shell gateway in P2/P3.

Racks/Core/MagicOrganizeUndo.cs.why: Directory.Delete(f) of a folder Magic Organize created, only when it is empty (non-recursive). P2 moves it to the broker.

Racks/Rack/WorkspaceReturn.cs.why: File.Delete of the workspace hardlink of a Ctrl+dropped file (the Desktop name keeps the same data). P2 moves it to the broker.

Racks/RackWindow.DragDrop.cs.why: Deletes the shortcut Racks itself created in a virtual rack after Explorer moved it out (1), and creates the VirtualFrames root and a new rack sandbox (2). P2 moves them to the broker.

Racks/RackWindow.Menu.cs.why: Directory.Delete(folder, false) of a rack folder on the Desktop that was just emptied (non-recursive, fails if anything is left). P2 moves it to the broker.

Racks/Util/CrashLog.cs.why: Appends to and rotates the app's own logs (crash.log, audit.log) under AppData. Not user data.

Racks/Util/JunctionHelper.cs.why: Creates the junction directory and removes it again on failure, plus its debug log. Operates on directories Racks just created.

Racks/Util/RackLayoutIO.cs.why: Writes the exported layout JSON to the file the user picked in the save dialog (a write, not a delete). P9 reviews it with the import/export rework.

Racks/Util/RackMirror.cs.why: Maintains the junction mirror folder under AppData (create root, remove stale reparse points only, non-recursive). The app's own folder, not user data. P2 reviews it.

Racks/Util/ShortcutFactory.cs.why: Copies a dropped .url shortcut file into the rack under a unique name (File.Copy never overwrites). P2 moves it to the broker.

Racks/Util/UninstallCleanup.cs.why: Rename-only return of user files on uninstall plus cleanup of the app's own folders (INV-UNINSTALL-1). Runs in a separate process; P2 moves the moves to MoveSameVolume and shrinks this.

Racks/Util/Updater.cs.why: Creates the private installer file and deletes the files and folder of its own per-run temp directory (Racks-update-<guid>). Not user data; P10 reworks the updater.
